fields.description: Issue includes a prominent report and commentary on Miami psychiatrist Dr. T. Earl Moore (the "Torture Doctor"), including a letter from former patient Colin Drake and discussion of patient suicides and alleged abuses connected to a cottage used for patients. Other coverage includes editorials opposing racetracks and legal gambling (with mention of Gamblers Anonymous), labor developments involving printers and Miami newspapers, calls to recall Florida legislators over a sales tax vote, and local Miami court/police items (shoplifting case at Shell's grocery, a blood donor fined for speeding, and notes on crematory advertising). Additional articles address Miami city commissioner Howard Leslie Quigg's record and a column on U.S. war preparations and reliance on West Germany in Cold War planning.
